notablePrerequisites:
You have no other cards in hand.
You have cast at least one instant or sorcery this turn.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least two token copies of Storm-Kiln Artist with haste.
Cast Hanabi Blast by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding Hanabi Blast.
Activate Bösium Strip by paying {3} and tapping it, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from the top of your graveyard this turn.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Hanabi Blast from the top of your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Each Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve Hanabi Blast, dealing 2 damage to any target, then returning Hanabi Blast to your hand and discarding Hanabi Blast.
Repeat from step 6.
